title: The image of the unit under an A-linear coherent derived equivalence is invertible
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The argument first forces the image of every residue field to be concentrated in one degree by ruling out negative self-extensions. It then detects all remaining cohomology of the image of A using finite-length test modules, Nakayama, and endomorphism rings. Recovering local shifts of rank-one free modules from categorical data is a substantive reconstruction argument.
